analysis.reason: Both tests exited with exitCode 1 and produced errors without any meaningful output to the 'out' port.
analysis.description: Both test cases (index 1 and 2) failed with exitCode 1, indicating runtime errors during execution. Neither test reached the point of returning data to the main 'out' port — both show 'unknown' as the output port, which means the component did not complete successfully. The output previews suggest the tests encountered a configuration or validation error early in execution (referencing a configstore path), preventing any actual contact creation from being tested. Since no test produced real data on the 'out' port and all tests returned non-zero exit codes, there are zero meaningful passing tests for the CreateContact component.
